title: Hummus with Hash Browns
description: A tasty and easy-to-make appetizer or snack, perfect for a quick lunch. Serve with hash browns for an added crunch.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine hummus, mashed avocado, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
3. Add shredded hash browns to the pan and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden brown.
4. Stir in lemon juice and minced garlic into the hummus mixture.
5. Serve the hummus mixture over the hash browns.
6. Garnish with additional avocado slices or lemon wedges, if desired.
